body:
Record what happens in the browser (clicks, typing, navigation) during a browser test run, so the run can be replayed in the replay renderer.

## Today
- The frontend has two pages, `app/page.tsx` and `app/search/page.tsx`, plus `components/cover.tsx`. There are no client components and no event capture of any kind.
- The only "replay" in the repo is the Elo replay over matchups (`lib/db/matchups.ts`, `REPLAY_ORDER`). It is unrelated to this ticket.
- The replay renderer is being built in another thread. Its input format is not in this repo yet, so the event format below is not settled.

## Scope
- Capture user interaction events in the browser while the app is under browser test: clicks, text input, and route changes.
- Give each event a timestamp and enough detail (event type, target, and value or path where relevant) for the renderer to redraw the session in order.
- Make the captured events available to the replay renderer in the format it reads. Agree that format with the renderer's ticket or thread before building.
- Tracking is off by default and turns on only for browser test runs.

## Acceptance
- A browser test run of the search page produces an ordered event log covering the clicks, typing and navigation in that run.
- The replay renderer can load that log and replay the run.
- With tracking off, the app sends and stores no events.

## Out of scope
- The replay renderer itself.
- Product analytics or tracking real users.
- Changes to the database (`lib/db`).
